from pathlib import Path
from collections import deque

code = '''from collections import deque

def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda c: sum(row.count(c) for row in grid))
    seen = set()
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == bg or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            q = [(r, c)]
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = set()
            while q:
                y, x = q.pop()
                cells.add((y, x))
                for yy, xx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
                    if 0 <= yy < h and 0 <= xx < w and (yy,xx) not in seen and grid[yy][xx] == color:
                        seen.add((yy,xx))
                        q.append((yy,xx))
            r0 = min(y for y,x in cells); r1 = max(y for y,x in cells)
            c0 = min(x for y,x in cells); c1 = max(x for y,x in cells)
            if r1-r0 < 2 or c1-c0 < 2:
                continue
            border = {(y,x) for y in range(r0,r1+1) for x in range(c0,c1+1)
                      if y in (r0,r1) or x in (c0,c1)}
            if cells != border:
                continue
            inner = [(y,x) for y in range(r0+1,r1) for x in range(c0+1,c1)]
            if not inner or any(grid[y][x] != bg for y,x in inner):
                continue
            fill = 2 if len(inner) % 2 == 0 else 7
            for y,x in inner:
                out[y][x] = fill
    return out
'''
